ats_new.title: AlphaSights Asia Case Competition 2027
ats_new.content: h3 Who We Are nbsp; /h3 p AlphaSights is the global leader in knowledge on-demand. Since 2008 we’ve been connecting investors and business leaders with the knowledge they need to succeed. Working from nine cities globally, our 1500+ colleagues provide round-the-clock coverage to the world’s top investment funds, consultancies, and businesses. Learn more about us at alphasights.com/careers. /p p As an Associate on our Client Service team, we operate at the commercial frontline. This is not consulting or research. Our Client Service team is the critical link between our top-tier clients and the expert knowledge they seek. Throughout a fast-paced day, they work on urgent projects from their assigned clients to rapidly understand their exact knowledge needs, and then find, engage, and vet the experts most suited to each situation. /p p nbsp; /p h3 Case Competition /h3 p Join the competition to understand how our clients make real-world business decisions powered by our services. You will work with your teammates to identify the knowledge gap of the business case and come up with potential experts who can help our clients make smarter business decisions. strong Finalists will be shortlisted and invited to our Hong Kong office for a final presentation with the opportunity to win HKD 8,000 (per team) and a fast-track interview process! /strong /p p nbsp; /p h3 Why participate? nbsp; /h3 ul li Learn how AlphaSights works with consulting firms, investment and corporate clients globally and understand the emerging information service industry /li li Demonstrate the ability to work in teams to solve real business problems /li li Establish relationships within the world’s leading professional services firm /li li The winning team will receive an HKD 8,000 cash prize, a fast-track interview process, and a trip to Hong Kong (cost covered)! nbsp; /li /ul p nbsp; /p h3 Eligibility /h3 ul li All participants should be currently enrolled, full-time undergraduate and postgraduate students in local or overseas universities /li li Each team must be comprised of 4 people /li li It is not required to have all team members from the same university to apply for the case competition /li /ul p nbsp; /p h3 Timeline /h3 ul li Application Deadline on Mar 1, 2027 /li li Case Launch on March 5, 2027 /li li Case Submission Deadline on April 2, 2027 /li li Result Announcement on May 3, 2027 /li li Final Presentation Day on June 2, 2027 /li /ul

ats_new.title: AlphaSights Launchpad 2027
ats_new.content: p strong About AlphaSights /strong /p p We bring together some of the most ambitious people from around the globe to work with the leading investment funds, strategy consultancies and Fortune 500 companies. Together, we help our clients access expert knowledge, elevate their decision-making and drive progress by connecting them with niche experts across the world. /p p Founded in 2008, our journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. With 2,000+ professionals in nine cities worldwide, we’ve earned our place as a leader in our market through our client service excellence, and integrating our proprietary technology to stay ahead of the curve. Our relentless pursuit of excellence means we only hire the best and brightest graduates to help us reach new heights. /p p nbsp; /p p strong AlphaSights Launchpad: Early Insights amp; Skill Development Programme /strong /p p If you are a curious first- or second-year full-time university student in Hong Kong eager to build business skills and get a head start, AlphaSights Launchpad is for you. /p p Join our exclusive three-day immersive programme at our Hong Kong office to discover how the world s leading knowledge-on-demand firm operates, develop core professional skills, get hands-on experience and connect directly with our people. /p p nbsp; /p p strong Inside the programme: What you ll do /strong /p p Over three dynamic half-days at our Hong Kong office, you will: /p ul li strong Explore Global Business: /strong Understand how companies operate, how value chains work, and the role of the knowledge-on-demand industry. /li li strong Develop Core Skills: /strong Participate in hands-on skill workshops covering case study cracking, pitching, effective communication, and project management. /li li strong Learn amp; Network: /strong Hear from AlphaSights leaders and receive personalised guidance from an assigned mentor during exclusive mentor lunches. /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong Who we re looking for /strong /p p We welcome ambitious full-time first- and second-year undergraduate students from all academic disciplines across Hong Kong universities. Ideal candidates bring: /p ul li Fluency in English (required), with proficiency in additional Asian languages being a strong plus. /li li A natural curiosity and passion for business and problem-solving. /li li Strong communication, teamwork, and interpersonal skills. /li li Proactive initiative and commitment to full participation across all three days. /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong What we offer /strong /p ul li strong Skill amp; Leadership Training: /strong Build commercial awareness and professional readiness early in your university journey. /li li strong Direct Mentorship: /strong Gain career advice and guidance from experienced AlphaSights professionals. /li li strong Early Career Advantage: /strong Expand your professional network and discover pathways to future internship and graduate opportunities at AlphaSights. /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong Event Details

ats_new.title: Associate, Client Service, Arabic Speaker, 2027
ats_new.content: p Looking to start your career in a fast-paced commercial role? Seeking to have immediate personal impact with a clear career path ahead of you? If so, our Associate Program is the right choice for you. /p p strong Springboard your career with us if: /strong /p ul li You thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. /li li You possess a client-first mindset. /li li You excel under pressure and enjoy working to tight deadlines. /li li You are gritty, resilient and ready to roll up your sleeves and make things happen. /li /ul p strong A day in the life of an Associate /strong /p p As an Associate in the Client Service team, you’ll be the link between our clients and the expert knowledge they seek. This is a communications-intense frontline role requiring you to multitask across parallel workstreams. /p p Your responsibilities will include: /p ul li strong Recruiting experts /strong : you will spend a significant part of your day speaking on the phone with experts who are uniquely relevant matches for your clients’ projects, often under tight deadlines. nbsp; /li li Understanding the strong project and market context /strong and the legal and regulatory environment in which your clients and experts operate. nbsp; /li li strong Taking ownership /strong of every aspect of your projects, from initiating and managing client-expert communications to meticulously scheduling calls to ensure seamless collaboration between them. /li /ul p strong Ensuring success for our Associates means: nbsp; /strong /p ol li Giving you an strong introduction to the /strong strong business world /strong without being pigeonholed into any one industry or profession. /li li Helping you strong develop transferable commercial and client management skills /strong spanning professional communications, negotiation, persuasion, project and time management. /li li A nbsp; strong data-stringify-type= bold clear career path for potential advancement /strong nbsp;to Manager after 24-30 months, and to Vice President after ~5 years. nbsp; /li li Successful completion of the Associate Program may qualify you for our strong MBA Tuition Program /strong , which provides financial support towards the program cost of some of the top business schools worldwide. /li /ol p strong Requirements /strong /p p You’ll need to bring your A game to work, daily. ats_new.content: p 入社月： 2026年 通年（1月〜10月） ※応相談 /p p *English follows Japanese /p hr p nbsp;ペースの早い環境で、営業的な業務からキャリアをスタートさせたい。 /p p 明確なキャリアパスを見据えながら、入社直後から、収益にインパクトを与えたい。 /p p アソシエイトプラグラムは、そのような方向けのポジションです。 /p p nbsp; /p p strong AlphaSightsについて /strong /p p AlphaSightsは、意欲的な人材を世界中から採用し、一流の投資ファンド、戦略コンサルティング会社、フォーチュン500企業に向けたビジネスを展開しています。私たちは、クライアントを世界中のエキスパートとつなげることで、クライアントが専門知識にアクセスし、より大局的な事業判断・事業成長ができるよう支援します。 /p p 2008年の創立以来、当社は傑出した成果を挙げてきました。世界9都市に2,000名以上のプロフェッショナルを擁し、卓越したクライアントサービスと独自テクノロジーの活用により、知識サーチ市場のリーダーとしての地位を確立しています。私たちはトップレベルの優秀な若手人材のみを採用し、さらなる高みを目指し続けています。 /p p nbsp; /p p strong こんな方に最適です /strong /p ul li スピード感のある、成果志向の環境で力を発揮できる方 /li li クライアントファーストのマインドセットをお持ちの方 /li li プレッシャーの中でも力を発揮し、テクノロジーを活用したワークフローでタイトな締め切りに対応できる方 /li li 粘り強く、レジリエンスがあり、自ら手を動かして物事を前に進められる方 /li li AIを含む新しいツールやワークフローを積極的に習得し、プロフェッショナルとしてのアウトプットを向上させることを楽しめる方 /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong アソシエイト業務について /strong /p p Client Service Teamのアソシエイトとして、クライアントが求める専門知識と彼らをつなぐ架け橋となります。投資家、戦略担当者、ディールメーカーなど、トップクラスのクライアント組織からの複数プロジェクトに同時に取り組みます。コミュニケーションが多く、複数のワークストリームを並行して進めるフロントラインの仕事です。 /p p 主な業務内容 /p ul li strong エキスパートとクライアント間のエンドツーエンドのコミュニケーション管理 /strong — 業務時間の大部分を電話でのエキスパートのスクリーニング・交渉に費やし、クライアントのリクエストに最適なマッチングを実現します。 /li li strong AIを活用したソーシングツール /strong を駆使し、複雑な業界バリューチェーンをマッピングし、関連するエキスパートを特定・アプローチします。 /li li クライアントやエキスパートが活動する strong プロジェクト・市場の背景 /strong 、および strong 法的・規制環境 /strong を理解します。 /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong アソシエイトの成功のために /strong /p ul li 特定の業界や職種に縛られない、幅広いビジネスの世界への入口を提供します。 /li li コミュニケーション、交渉、説得、プロジェクト・タイムマネジメントなど、実践的なビジネススキルとクライアントマネジメント力が身に付きます。 /li li 24～30か月後にマネージャー、最短で5年後にはバイスプレジデントへの昇進など明確なキャリアパスが用意されています。 /li li アソシエイトプログラム修了者は、世界トップビジネススクールの学費を支援するMBA Tuition Programへの応募資格が得られます。 /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong 応募要件 /strong /p p 日々、自分のできる最高のパフォーマンスで業務に臨むことを期待しています。 /p ul li 優れた学業成績（目安：成績80%以上。GPA 3.2/4.0、英国式2:1以上に相当） /li li 高校・大学での課外活動において、特筆すべき経験がある /li li このポジションに関連するインターンシップなどの経験 /li li ビジネスレベル以上の流暢な日本語と英語の能力 /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong 給与・福利厚生 /strong /p ul li 1年目の総報酬：¥7,000,000 (平均的なパフォーマンス) to ¥8,600,000(ハイパフォーマー)。 /li /ul p style= padding-left: 40px; ※内訳 ①固定基本給年額5,100,000円 ②業績に応じた能力給（上限なし） /p p style= padding-left: 40px; ※固定基本給年額には1ヶ月あたり40時間分の固定残業手当が含まれます /p ul li 社会保険完備 /li li 入社1年目より有給休暇15日、傷病休暇5日を付与 /li li 祝日に勤務する場合は、年間休暇日数を追加で付与 /li li 通勤手当あり /li li 出産休暇6ヵ月間、男性の育児休暇6週間 /li li 東京タワーに近い都心で、アメニティの充実したオフィスです。毎週金曜日は、自宅勤務のオプションがあります。 /li /ul p nbsp;
